decided: A flow's baseline, recovery and reconcile blocks become optional. A present block is validated exactly as before, and a present-but-empty block (`baseline: {}`) is still rejected as the typo it is; only an absent block is accepted. The legs that consume them do not guess: with no baseline the unrealized leg is marked Unavailable with a note naming the missing block — and the leg is now marked Unavailable whenever no requested flow could be sized, which it was not before; with no recovery block the estimate credits nothing back and its note says so, distinct from a declared fraction of zero; with no reconcile source nothing changes at impact time, because coverage is a reconcile-time number whose ledger arrives on the CLI, and the registry reference says the block is where Finance names that ledger. The portability contract's `reconcile_source_required` class narrows to a reconcile block that names no source, and an accepted vector carries the minimal flow. The quickstart registry shrinks to money and stages.
why: The 2026-09-03 review found the first-run registry carried three Finance concepts before any number appeared, and the quickstart itself calls the values placeholders. The rule those blocks enforced — the legs that need them must not silently guess — is kept by ADR-0017's mechanism instead of by rejection: a leg without its block says so. That is the same discipline the deferred and coverage legs already follow, and it is a better first-run experience than a validator error about a ledger the adopter has not chosen.
cost_if_wrong: A flow that forgets its baseline now gets a report whose unrealized line reads unavailable with the block named, instead of a validator error at startup; the note is loud and the CLI's validate verb still runs, so the omission is visible before an incident. A present-but-malformed block is rejected as before, so the change admits no new bad configuration, only an absent one.
alternatives: Keep the blocks required and let `shortfall init` scaffold them — rejected: the quickstart would still carry placeholder Finance values the adopter is told to ignore.

Default the blocks silently (an eight-week baseline, sixty percent recovery) — rejected outright: a defaulted baseline is a guess about the adopter's demand, which is the thing the design rule forbids.
Make only reconcile optional — rejected: baseline and recovery are the two the quickstart least needs, and their consumers already degrade honestly.
scope: registry/registry.go (pointer doc types for the three blocks, validation only when present, reworded reconcile message); registry/registry_test.go; engine/unrealized.go (Unavailable when no flow was sized, notes for absent baseline and recovery); engine/unrealized_test.go; testkit/cmd/genvectors (accepted minimal-flow vector) and the regenerated testkit/vectors/registry.json; docs/portability/registry.md; docs/quickstart.md; docs/registry.md; README design rules; docs/adr/0020 and the index. No wire change, no query-surface change, no gate-surface change.
